The team had a short clock and a bird to build: a hen. Hana picked it, saying the café's own hens wander between the tables and the kids love them. Sofia raised a flag that the café is vegetarian and a donkey might suit better, but Hana kept the hen. Hana laid the beak, comb and tail. Sofia took the belly, Omar the left leg, and Jack the right.

The turning point came when the back line stalled. Hana couldn't see it on the table, and Omar explained that it was "stuck waiting on the leg join." He carried it on from the belly end, and it began to climb. Jack re-laid the right leg where the turn was too sharp, and Sofia re-laid the left, where the gap by the belly was too big to nudge.

With little time left, Sofia raised the donkey idea again. Hana replied, "We're staying with the hen, no swap," and the team closed the last gaps. When the push came, 152 of 170 fell. Blind judges mostly saw a chicken or hen, though a few guessed a dove or a duck.
